A selection of what I'm working on now. Most of my day-to-day work happens in the open through NOAA's Ecosystem Dynamics and Assessment Branch ([NOAA-EDAB](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB)) on GitHub.

## Current work

::: {.project-grid}

::: {.project-card}
### State of the Ecosystem

Workflows behind the annual State of the Ecosystem reports for the New England and Mid-Atlantic Fishery Management Councils, which summarize ecosystem indicators for managers.

[ecodata](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/ecodata) · [NEFMC report](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/SOE-NEFMC) · [MAFMC report](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/SOE-MAFMC) · [Technical docs](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/tech-doc)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### survdat

An R package for pulling and working with NEFSC bottom trawl survey data.

[GitHub](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/survdat) · [Documentation](https://noaa-edab.github.io/survdat/)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Rpath / Rsim fitting

Fitting Rsim, the dynamic simulation component of the Rpath ecosystem model, to observed time series.

[GitHub](https://github.com/NOAA-EDAB/Rpath)
:::
